title: Relative flat locus of an algebraic-space map commutes with base change
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and let $X,Y,Z$ be algebraic spaces over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space] in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $p:X\to Z$, $q:Y\to Z$, and $f:X\to Y$ satisfy $q\circ f=p$. Assume $p$ is flat and locally of finite presentation and $q$ is locally of finite type, with the chartwise meanings of [def-sfb-space-morphism-properties]. A point $x\in|X|$ is a flat point of $f$ if for every compatible etale scheme-chart diagram $U\to V$ over $X\to Y$ and every $u\in U$ mapping to $x$, the scheme map $U\to V$ is flat at $u$ in the local-ring sense of [def-weil-flat-morphism]. Put $L=\{x\in|X|:f\text{ is flat at }x\}$. Point spaces and their topology are [def-a1-space-point-topology]. Then $L$ is open in $|X|$. For every algebraic-space morphism $h:Z\prime\to Z$, let $f_{Z\prime}:X\times_Z Z\prime\to Y\times_Z Z\prime$ be the base change, and $a:X\times_Z Z\prime\to X$ the projection [lem-trf-space-fibre-products-etale-covers]. The set of flat points of $f_{Z\prime}$ is exactly $|a|^{-1}(L)$.

source.place: Tag 05X3 (lemma-base-change-flatness-fibres), full statement; pointwise flatness is the etale-chart definition (spaces-morphisms.tex, definition-flat and lemma-flat-local).

proof.text: Choose a surjective etale scheme atlas $c:W\to Z$, then an atlas $V\to Y\times_ZW$, and finally an atlas $U\to X\times_YV$. Fibre products and composition of etale coverings give surjective etale maps $b:V\to Y$ and $a:U\to X$ and compatible scheme maps $g:U\to V$ and $V\to W$. In particular the composites $U\to W$ and $V\to W$ are chart diagrams for $p$ and $q$. By their chart tests, $U\to W$ is flat and locally of finite presentation and $V\to W$ is locally of finite type. These are exactly the hypotheses of the scheme relative-flat-locus theorem; no finiteness or flatness of $g$ is being assumed.

source.place: Tag 05X2, proof first reduction sentence; Tag 05WY (lemma-flat-on-fibres-at-point), proof construction of U,V,W; spaces.tex Tag 02X1 (lemma-lift-morphism-presentations).

proof.text: Apply the scheme relative-flat-locus theorem to $U\to V\to W$: its flat locus $E\subseteq|U|$ is open. Choice independence of pointwise flatness in the strict-local-flatness lemma says that $g$ is flat at $u$ if and only if $f$ is flat at $a(u)$: one compatible chart detects the same condition as every compatible chart in the item. Thus $E=|a|^{-1}(L)$. The atlas $a$ is surjective on point sets and gives the quotient topology on $|X|$, so openness of $E$ proves openness of $L$ (and also $L=|a|(E)$).

source.place: Tag 05X2, reduction to schemes and the sentence identifying A as the image of the scheme open; schemes Tag 05VK (lemma-base-change-flatness-fibres); spaces-morphisms.tex Tag 04NG (lemma-flat-at-point-etale-local-rings); spaces-properties.tex Tag 03BX (lemma-topology-points).

proof.text: Fix any $h:Z^{\prime}\to Z$ and write $X^{\prime}=X\times_ZZ^{\prime}$ and $Y^{\prime}=Y\times_ZZ^{\prime}$. Choose a surjective etale scheme atlas $W^{\prime}\to W\times_ZZ^{\prime}$, and set $U^{\prime}=U\times_WW^{\prime}$ and $V^{\prime}=V\times_WW^{\prime}$. These are schemes. Their maps $a^{\prime}:U^{\prime}\to X^{\prime}$ and $b^{\prime}:V^{\prime}\to Y^{\prime}$ are surjective etale: for example $U^{\prime}\to U\times_ZZ^{\prime}$ is the pullback of $W^{\prime}\to W\times_ZZ^{\prime}$, while $U\times_ZZ^{\prime}\to X^{\prime}$ is the pullback of $a$. Etale coverings survive these pullbacks and compose. The same argument applies to $V^{\prime}$. The chart map $g^{\prime}:U^{\prime}\to V^{\prime}$ is precisely $g$ base changed along the scheme map $W^{\prime}\to W$. If $r:U^{\prime}\to U$ and $\pi:X^{\prime}\to X$ are the projections, then $a r=\pi a^{\prime}$, as follows by evaluating their fibre-product coordinates.

source.place: Tag 05X2, proof: choose W-prime covering W times_Z Z-prime, then U-prime and V-prime; etale covering stability is spaces-topologies.tex Tag 041F (lemma-etale).

proof.text: Let $L^{\prime}$ be the flat-point set of $f_{Z^{\prime}}$ and $E^{\prime}$ that of $g^{\prime}$. The arbitrary scheme-base-change clause applied to $g$ gives $E^{\prime}=|r|^{-1}(E)$. The same choice-independent chart test as in step 2 gives $E^{\prime}=|a^{\prime}|^{-1}(L^{\prime})$. Substituting $E=|a|^{-1}(L)$ and $a r=\pi a^{\prime}$ yields $|a^{\prime}|^{-1}(L^{\prime})=|a^{\prime}|^{-1}(|\pi|^{-1}(L))$. Surjectivity of $|a^{\prime}|$ now proves $L^{\prime}=|\pi|^{-1}(L)$: for each $x^{\prime}$ choose $u^{\prime}$ above it and read membership through this equality. This covers arbitrary algebraic-space parameter changes, including empty charts and fibres.

source.place: Tag 05X2, proof final three sentences, specializing the module to the structure sheaf as in Tag 05X3; scheme theorem Tag 05VK; chart independence Tag 04NG.

There are no new nodes and the statement is unchanged; the base item had no proof, so this is not a re-split. The statement matches Stacks 05X3 (spaces-more-morphisms.tex l.5917) exactly and is not weakened. The proof follows 05X2 (l.5872): the 05WY(3) chart triple U→V→W, then for Z'→Z a scheme atlas W'→W×_ZZ' with U'=U×_WW' and V'=V×_WW'. I matched every cited tag against tags/tags, and no SGA source is used. Step 1: a and b are etale coverings because an atlas composed with a base-changed covering is again one (fibre-products and chartwise-permanence nodes). The chart test of def-sfb-space-morphism-properties gives U→W flat and lfp and V→W lft, which are the hypotheses of the scheme theorem lem-sfb-relative-flat-locus-base-change (05VK). Step 2: the 'independent of choices' clause of lem-sfb-space-strict-local-flatness makes the exists and for-all chart tests the same, so E=|a|^{-1}(L) and L=|a|(E). L is open because |a| is open (last clause of lem-a1-space-affine-etale-cover). Step 3: I checked U'≅(U×_ZZ')×_{W×_ZZ'}W', so a' is a composite of two base-changed coverings, and g'=g×_WW' is compatible with f_{Z'}. Step 4: the base-change clause with T=W' gives E'=r^{-1}(E), the chart test gives E'=|a'|^{-1}(L'), and surjectivity of |a'| gives L'=|π|^{-1}(L). Edge cases checked: empty X, empty Z' or fibres, f=id, and a non-schematic W×_ZZ'. I accept the three generic tool_uses (atlas, fibre products, etale permanence). Batch-5 check, each citation is outside both assumptions: lem-a1-space-affine-etale-cover only reaches the definition def-trf-algebraic-space; lem-trf-space-chartwise-etale-permanence is generic Stacks 03FT-03FV etale permanence and not a step of the trace-formula proof; lem-sfb-relative-flat-locus-base-change reaches lem-trf-localization-finite-presentation-ring-map, which is commutative algebra; lem-sfb-space-strict-local-flatness only reaches the definition def-trf-algebraic-space. No duplicate algebraic-space flat-locus node exists in the DAG. Advisory only: the statement calls the projection 'a', while the proof uses 'a' for the chart and 'π' for the projection; step 3 defines π explicitly, so the argument is not ambiguous.
